LanguageData.LP_NetherilUndead.label: demilich body
LanguageData.LP_NetherilUndead.description: An undead body Larloch sustains with Netherese arcana: feels no pain, needs no food or sleep. Casts fear gaze and necrotic blast when enemies are nearby.
LanguageData.LP_LarlochAvatar.label: avatar of the Shadow King
LanguageData.LP_LarlochAvatar.description: This isn't Larloch himself, only one of his avatars: part health ×2, feels no pain, can use fear gaze and necrotic blast, and is always shrouded in a life-draining aura. The avatar won't revive when it dies.
LanguageData.LP_ThayEliteMage.label: Thayan elite wizard
LanguageData.LP_ThayEliteMage.description: A Red Wizard carefully trained by Thay; protective incantations reduce damage taken by 40%.
LanguageData.LP_PhylacteryLost.label: lich without phylactery
LanguageData.LP_PhylacteryLost.description: This lich's phylactery is in the hands of Larloch the Shadow King. The lich keeps all abilities and phylactery level, but will no longer revive after death and can't make sacrifices to the phylactery anymore.
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneDemigod.label: arcane demigod
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneDemigod.description: The Weave has accepted this person: max neural heat ×2, psyfocus regain ×2, no longer ages, needs no food, psycast cooldowns halved, one "oracle" per day. There can be only one arcane demigod in the world.
